brand.name: Hawaa
brand.tagline: Dignity in Every Drop. Ending Period Poverty through Corporate Solidarity.
brand.meaning: Named after Hawaa (Eve in Arabic/Persian) and founder Amena Rahjo's niece.

typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold text-slate-900

key_components.name: HeroHeader
key_components.description: Kinetic text reveal with 3D floating marshmallow clouds parallax effect, interactive stats badges, and quick CTA buttons for corporate sponsorship & shop.

key_components.name: EditorialMarquee
key_components.description: Slow drift ribbon featuring GOTS certifications, partner foundations, and corporate commitment logos.

key_components.name: ImpactStatsBento
key_components.description: Bento grid displaying verified Netherlands period poverty statistics (25% unable to afford, 21% unsafe alternatives, Amsterdam 14% target down from 27%).

key_components.name: BuyOneGiftOneShop
key_components.description: E-commerce product cards for organic pads/tampons with interactive cart & Stripe simulated checkout logic, directly funding community distribution.

key_components.name: CorporatePackages
key_components.description: Tiered sponsorship packages (Seed, Growth, Sanctuary) with employee headcount calculator and custom quote request.

key_components.name: CorporateEnquiryForm
key_components.description: Full-featured form with backend validation and instant SQLite database recording via FastAPI API endpoints.

key_components.name: FourPhaseRoadmap
key_components.description: Visual timeline for Pilot in Amsterdam (€15k-20k target) through nationwide corporate roll-out.

key_components.name: DonateModal
key_components.description: Quick-action donation dialog for direct public support.

key_components.name: AdminEnquiriesDashboard
key_components.description: Protected/toggleable dashboard to view, filter, update, and export corporate enquiries.

testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements must include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='enquiry-submit-btn', data-testid='shop-buy-now-btn').
